title: Learn Colors with Pip! Red Blue Green 🎨 Kids Song
script: Hi friends! Let's learn colors with Pip! / Red apple, look so bright! / Blue star, shining light! / Green sun, oh what fun! / Yay! Let's sing it again!

title: Learn to Count 1 to 3 with Momo! 🎈 BoomBoo Kids
script: Let's count balloons with Momo! / One red balloon up high! / Two blue balloons fly by! / Three yellow balloons we see! / Yay! Count again with me!
